adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute the fallback calendar id as `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` in the branch where `externalCalendarId` is falsy. Since the predicate compares against a falsy `externalCalendarId` (e.g. `undefined`/`null`), it will not match a real `externalId` string, so the expression yields `undefined` and the code cannot correctly fall back to the event’s destination calendar. This is a real regression from the previous `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` behavior and can cause deletes/updates to target the wrong calendar (e.g. defaulting to primary or failing), leaving external events orphaned when references lack `externalCalendarId`.
